blogPosts.title: Signs Your Mulgrave Roof Needs Repair After Winter
blogPosts.excerpt: Identify common roof damage signs in Mulgrave homes post-winter, from leaks to tile issues, and learn when to call a professional roofer.
body: After Melbourne's wet winter, Mulgrave homeowners should inspect their roofs for damage. Common signs include water stains on ceilings, indicating leaks from cracked tiles or faulty flashing. Ignoring these can lead to mold growth and structural issues, especially in Mulgrave's humid climate.

Check for missing or broken tiles, often caused by heavy rain or wind. In Mulgrave, where storms are frequent, tiles can shift or crack, exposing underlayment to elements. Professional roofers like PorterVac can assess this during a free inspection, recommending repairs before problems escalate.

Another sign is sagging gutters or downpipes, which suggest blockages or water accumulation. After winter, debris buildup can strain the system, leading to overflow and foundation damage. Mulgrave properties with large trees nearby are particularly vulnerable, making spring an ideal time for gutter cleaning.

Daylight visible through roof boards is a red flag for structural weakness. In Mulgrave homes, especially older ones, this could mean timber rot from moisture. Prompt repairs by licensed tilers ensure safety and prevent costly restorations, which can exceed $5,000 if delayed.

Energy inefficiency is another clue; if your Mulgrave home feels colder, it might be due to roof gaps letting heat escape. Insulation checks during a roof repair can improve comfort and reduce bills. Australian standards recommend regular roof assessments to maintain energy efficiency.

When in doubt, consult a Mulgrave roofing expert. Providers with 7-year guarantees, like PorterVac, offer reliable solutions tailored to local conditions. Early intervention saves money and protects your home, making post-winter inspections a wise practice for all Mulgrave residents.
